subject: Coordinating multi-region demo & procurement checkpoint — OrionCloud
messages:
From: Alice Rios <alice.rios@orioncloud.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@orioncloud.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@orioncloud.com>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@kumo-inc.jp>
Date: 2026-12-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Planning session + demo — aligning SE and procurement

Hi Evelyn / David —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We’d like to lock in a short technical demo (45 min) focused on inference latency/cost controls and a separate procurement checkpoint (15–20 min) for contract/sso/scoping. Attendees we’d like on our side: myself (platform lead), Rajiv (security), procurement@orioncloud.com, and Kenji (APAC infra).

Because we have stakeholders across US/EU/APAC, can you propose a pair of sessions that rotate ownership so no one is always on the late call? Quick availability from our side (local):
- Tue 2026-12-21: 09:00–11:00 PT / 17:00–19:00 CET (works for US morning / EU evening)
- Wed 2026-12-22: 22:00–23:30 PT / Thu 2026-12-23 06:00–07:30 JST (Kenji can only join these windows)

Ideal plan:
1) Technical demo with SE (45 min) — walk through architecture, expected throughput, and KV/prefix caching behavior for our workloads.
2) Procurement + security quick call to confirm SOW timeline and provisioning model.

Can David or Steph join the technical demo? Procurement prefers the shorter slot to be scheduled immediately after the demo (or a dedicated 20-min slot same week).

Thanks,
Alice
Platform Lead — OrionCloud

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Rios <alice.rios@orioncloud.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@orioncloud.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@orioncloud.com>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@kumo-inc.jp>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-18T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Planning session + demo — aligning SE and procurement

Hi Alice —

Thanks — we can absolutely run that. David will own the commercial flow and I’ll loop Steph in as the SE for the technical demo. Given cross-region constraints I propose a "time-bridge" approach: we run two shorter technical walkthroughs spread across the week so each region has a friendly window and the core team rotates. Proposal:

Option A (EU-friendly primary):
- Demo 1 (deep technical): Tue 2026-12-21 16:00–16:45 CET (07:00–07:45 PT) — good for EU + US overlap
- Procurement checkpoint: Tue 2026-12-21 17:00–17:20 CET (08:00–08:20 PT)

Option B (APAC-friendly primary):
- Demo 2 (deep technical): Wed 2026-12-22 06:30–07:15 JST (22:30–23:15 PT Tue) — aligns with Kenji
- Procurement checkpoint: Wed 2026-12-22 07:20–07:40 JST (23:20–23:40 PT Tue)

We can run both (two demos) or pick a single session and rotate future demos. Quick notes:
- Steph, do you have any constraints on Tue morning PT / Wed late PT?
- Alice, is it acceptable to run two 45-min sessions in the same week rather than one long call? That lets us keep the technical segment compact and tailored to each region’s questions.

I’ll attach a short checklist for the demo env and a draft SOW for procurement to review.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Rios <alice.rios@orioncloud.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@orioncloud.com>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@kumo-inc.jp>
Date: 2026-12-18T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Planning session + demo — aligning SE and procurement

On Fri, Dec 18, 2026 at 11:03 AM PST Evelyn Hart wrote:
> Steph, do you have any constraints on Tue morning PT / Wed late PT?

I can do both proposed windows this week as long as we confirm the scope up front. Requesting the following prep from OrionCloud so we can make the 45-min session efficient:
- Top 3 latency/cost pain points (one-line each)
- Representative token/sec distribution + typical prompt lengths
- Any compliance/SSO constraints (Rajiv, does Orion prefer SAML or OIDC?)

I’ve attached a lightweight demo-setup-checklist.pdf that lists ports, example payloads, and a quick perf-run script we usually use. If they can upload a small sample (<= 100 prompts) to the Drive link ahead of time I’ll pre-run a quick profile.

Also: we should confirm whether they want the demo on Hosted Redwood API or if they prefer a Dedicated simulation (affects what I demo live).

– Steph
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: Procurement <procurement@orioncloud.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Rios <alice.rios@orioncloud.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@orioncloud.com>
Date: 2026-12-19T08:07:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Planning session + demo — aligning SE and procurement

Thanks — procurement here. We need a short SOW and a rough monthly estimate before we can schedule a procurement-only approval slot. Our preferred cadence is a 15–20 minute review with commercial terms and an initial timeline. Attached is a redlined template where we added a few vendor questions (see section 3: data residency).

Preferred slots (London timezone):
- Tue 2026-12-21 09:30–09:50 GMT
- Wed 2026-12-22 14:00–14:20 GMT

We see Option A matches our first preferred slot (the 17:00 CET / 08:00 PT time Evelyn suggested). Please confirm and send a short SOW draft.

Procurement — OrionCloud
(attachment: SOW-draft-v1.docx)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Rios <alice.rios@orioncloud.com>, Procurement <procurement@orioncloud.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@orioncloud.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@kumo-inc.jp>
Date: 2026-12-20T16:42:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Planning session + demo — aligning SE and procurement

Thanks all — finalizing schedule below and adding a rotating plan for subsequent weeks so the same team isn’t always on late calls. Calendar invites will follow (I’ve included the Calendly link below for any quick swaps).

Confirmed this week (both sessions):
- Demo (EU-focused): Tue 2026-12-21 16:00–16:45 CET / 07:00–07:45 PT — SE: Stephanie (live demo of Hosted API with caching examples)
- Procurement checkpoint: Tue 2026-12-21 17:00–17:20 CET / 08:00–08:20 PT — David will run the procurement review; Evelyn & Rajiv will join for security questions
- APAC follow-up demo (recorded + live Q&A for Kenji): Wed 2026-12-22 06:30–07:15 JST / Tue 2026-12-22 22:30–23:15 PT — optional for APAC live attendees; recording to be posted

Rotation plan (high level):
- Week 1: EU-primary demo times as above (rotate APAC to recorded session)
- Week 2: APAC-primary demo window (Kenji’s preferred live slot) with EU getting a later playback; commercial team alternates to avoid burnout

Action items:
- David: send a short SOW (v0) by EOD 2026-12-20 — attaching SOW-draft-v1.docx and I’ll iterate.
- Alice / Rajiv: please upload the 3 pain points + sample prompts to the Drive link before 2026-12-21 04:00 PT.
- Steph: please pre-run the perf script on any sample they upload and share a short profile.

Calendly (for swaps): https://calendly.com/redwood/orioncloud-demo
HubSpot: hubspot:HS-ORC-4721
Drive notes: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1_demo_notes

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Evelyn Hart
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
